{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the data
print(df.head())
print(df.dtypes)
print(df.isnull().sum())

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 in customer_age: {(df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()}")

# Check for the QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded)}")

# Check unique values in customer_segment
print(f"Unique customer_segment values: {df['customer_segment'].unique()}")

# Check conversion rate by segment
conversion_by_segment = df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()
print("Conversion rate by segment:\n", conversion_by_segment)"}
